Technical Reports

The SUTR series — normative specifications, tracked per release.

Technical Reports formalize each contract of the standard. They play the role of Unicode’s UAX/UTR documents and are identified by the SUTR-n scheme with per-version errata.

Report Status Scope
SUTS-001 Draft — Ratified SuperUnicode Collation Algorithm (SUCA) — UCA-equivalent multilevel collation, 64-bit extSUCS compatible
SUAS-001 Draft — Ratified Structural Directional Framing (SDF) — core BiDi architecture, scope isolation and glyph mirroring
SUAS-002 Draft — Ratified System Glyph Width & Monospace Grid (SGW) — fixed-cell terminal metrics, EAW-style width over 64-bit SUCS
SUAS-003 Draft — Ratified System Boundary & Line Break Rules (SBR) — single-pass line breaking over 64-bit SUCS
SUAS-004 Draft — Ratified SuperUnicode Canonical Forms (SUCF) — dual-target canonical (de)composition, zero allocation
SUTR-0 0.1.0 SUCS Core — hierarchy, three-space layout, SCP, Traps, Sentinel
SUTR-1 0.1.0 SUTF — SUCS UTF-8/16/32 framing
SUTR-2 0.1.0 SUCA — SuperUnicode Collation Algorithm
SUTR-3 0.1.0 SuperUnicode Storage — OWFS/USFS partition policy
SUTR-4 0.1.0 ExtSUCS Transport — vector, vsutf, e-SUST
SUTR-5 0.1.0 Plugin Lifecycle & Blob Format — stage, checksum gate, mount, registry
SUTR-6 0.1.0 Unicode Compatibility Bridge — the permanent 1:1 guarantee

Core invariants every report honors

  • SUCS_CP is 31-bit; sucs_ex_char_t is 64-bit.
  • 0x000000–0x10FFFF is permanently 1:1 with Unicode.
  • 0x7FFFFFFF is the Sentinel; no allocation exists at or below it.
  • Plugin codepoints start strictly above 0x7FFFFFFF and mount only after the checksum gate.
